_comment: DRAFT. The only definition of status words. Applet and host constants are generated from this file. 'source: card' means the card returns it. 'source: host' means the host library reports it by name and it never appears on the wire. 'x' in a value is a hex digit that carries a number.

codes.name: Ok
codes.meaning: Success.

codes.name: PinWrong
codes.meaning: Wrong PIN. x is the number of tries left.
codes.host_action: Show tries left for this card. Never retry on its own.

codes.name: PinBlocked
codes.meaning: No PIN tries left. The card is LOCKED for good.
codes.host_action: Tell the user this card must be replaced by share repair.

codes.name: PinRequired
codes.meaning: The command needs a verified PIN.

codes.name: WrongState
codes.meaning: The command is not allowed in the card's lifecycle state.

codes.name: BadData
codes.meaning: Malformed input: wrong length, value out of range, bad order.

codes.name: BadParams
codes.meaning: Unknown P1 or P2.

codes.name: UnknownInstruction
codes.meaning: Unknown INS.

codes.name: UnknownClass
codes.meaning: Unknown CLA.

codes.name: Internal
codes.meaning: Unexpected failure inside the card, including a counter that cannot increase.
codes.host_action: Stop. Report the card and the command. Do not retry.

codes.name: OutOfOrderStep
codes.meaning: A step arrived without the step before it: SIGN with an empty nonce slot, PEERS without START, FINALIZE without PEERS, HELP2 without HELP1.

codes.name: SessionSuperseded
codes.meaning: SIGN named a session that a later COMMIT replaced.

codes.name: CommitmentMismatch
codes.meaning: The card's own commitment in the SIGN input differs from the one it produced.

codes.name: HostFault
codes.meaning: A DKG coordinator message contradicts what this card sent (its own commitment or public nonce).
codes.host_action: Abort setup. The host or the link altered a message.

codes.name: DkgShareInvalid
codes.meaning: The card's DKG share does not match the public commitments. The faulty party is not known.
codes.host_action: Abort setup, wipe all cards, run again.

codes.name: ReshareRefused
codes.meaning: The share-repair authorization is missing, invalid, or not from an offline card.

codes.name: ReshareIncomplete
codes.meaning: The recipient could not rebuild a share that matches the public share. Nothing was stored. The recipient is still READY.
codes.host_action: Warn that the position has no card. Run the repair again.

codes.name: ChainingError
codes.meaning: A command chain was broken or longer than the input buffer.

codes.name: UnsupportedParams
codes.meaning: t and n are not 2 and 4.

codes.name: UnsupportedProfile
codes.meaning: The install parameter is not a known card profile. Returned at install.

codes.name: BadPoint
codes.meaning: An input is not a valid curve point.

codes.name: DkgInvalidShare
codes.meaning: The proof of possession or commitment of the participant at position x is invalid. The host may also be the cause.
codes.host_action: Abort setup. Name the card at position x.

codes.name: PeerStateMismatch
codes.meaning: The DKG certificate signature of the participant at position x is invalid: that card did not agree on the same transcript.
codes.host_action: Abort setup. Name the card at position x. Never retry on its own.

codes.name: ExfilCheckFailed
codes.meaning: Reserved for anti-exfiltration. Not used until spec/anti-exfil.md is reviewed.
codes.host_action: Loud alert naming position x. Never retry on its own.

codes.name: NonceStateLost
codes.meaning: A signing session ended without a share, for example a power cut during SIGN. The nonce is gone.
codes.host_action: Start a new session with COMMIT on every signer. Never resend SIGN for the old session.

codes.name: DkgAborted
codes.meaning: Setup stopped before all four cards were KEYED with the same group key.
codes.host_action: Wipe all four cards and start again.

codes.name: NoRedundancy
codes.meaning: A position has no working card.
codes.host_action: Warn on every command until a repair succeeds.
